content: Hello? My campaign run #VID12345 shows stuck in processing for the past 3 hours but my email launch is scheduled. Where are my videos? I've been waiting for too long!

I understand your urgency, sir. Let me check your campaign run details right away. I can see campaign #VID12345 was initiated at 8:15 PM and is stuck. Give me a moment to check the server logs and render queue records.
Yes please. I checked my webhooks and none have fired yet. The rendering engine seems completely frozen for my batch.

You're right, I can see from our system logs that your campaign assets triggered an edge-case memory limit on our standard rendering node. This caused the batch queue to stall. I'm going to initiate a manual override right now to move your campaign to a high-capacity GPU server to finish processing. I'm also refunding the 5,000 video credits spent on this run, and adding 500 bonus rendering credits as compensation.
Okay, I appreciate the credit refund and bonus. But what about my campaign launch schedule? My marketing team is waiting and leads will be lost if this is delayed further.

I completely understand and apologize for the impact on your schedule. I am monitoring the high-capacity server queue for you now. The batch has started processing and should complete in about 15-20 minutes. I will apply a priority tag on your account so that all future render batches bypass standard queues and render instantly. I will personally supervise this run until all webhook notifications are successfully sent to your server.
That's better. At least someone is taking responsibility. Can you also check if our custom domain and SSL are fine? We don't want leads landing on a broken page once videos are ready.

Absolutely. I've verified your custom domain integration and SSL certificate. Both are active and fully operational. Browser landing pages are ready to serve the interactive videos as soon as the rendering completes. I apologize again on behalf of Infosys Springboard. We will make sure your campaign goes live smoothly.
Alright. I'll monitor the dashboard now. Thank you for helping.

You're welcome! Your credits have been refunded and the bonus 500 credits are active. I will keep this ticket open and post an update here once the batch rendering completes. Have a successful campaign launch!
